content:
kevin-ps: FYI — VegaHealth is migrating Dedicated -> Private on 2026-04-01. They have an outstanding invoice INV-2026-0423 for platform fee + reserved capacity that covers Mar 15–Apr 14. Sales says we promised to not bill platform fee for the first full month of Private. We need to reconcile and issue a credit for the overlap.

maria-finance: Do we have the invoice lines? need amount, GL, and PO to route credit.

kevin-ps: Attached in previous thread (sent to elaine). Quick summary: INV-2026-0423 line items:
- PLATFORM_FEE: $12,500 (Mar 15–Apr 14)
- RESERVED_CAPACITY: $28,000 (monthly commit)
PO from procurement: PO-89234 references the legacy Dedicated contract.

elaine-am: Confirming — I told Vega we'd apply a one-month platform fee credit when they sign Private. Sales didn't escalate to finance to pre-create the credit. Customer is waiting on invoice adjustment before they close their internal fiscal month.

samir-billing: Got it. Two blockers: (1) We need a formal approval from finance lead to issue non-standard credit (platform fee waiver) tied to PO-89234. (2) We need to ensure we don't double-credit the reserved capacity commit.

natasha-legal: Any contract addendum for the migration? If the platform fee waiver is a one-off concession, document it with a short addendum signed by sales and customer (email is fine). Also confirm no change to support tier.

elaine-am: Customer kept same Support: Platinum (S1). No changes.

maria-finance: Approve provisional credit of $12,500 to cover platform fee overlap, pending CR creation and GL mapping. Finance lead sign-off: @sanjay? (cc @natasha-legal for addendum language)

sanjay-finance: Approved. Please include reason code MIGRATION_OVERLAP and tag GL 5-120-PLAT. Limit: one-off credit equal to PLATFORM_FEE line. No impact to reserved capacity charges.

samir-billing: Thanks. Preparing credit note. Command I will run in billing system:
```
/create-credit --customer VEGA --amount 12500 --currency USD --reason "MIGRATION_OVERLAP" --po PO-89234 --gl 5-120-PLAT --ref INV-2026-0423
```

billing-bot: Credit note CR-2026-058 created for $12,500 against INV-2026-0423. Status: pending-apply. Ticket: BILL-5578.

samir-billing: Applied credit, posted to AR. Customer will receive adjusted invoice later today. Sending reconciliation note to accounting for month-end close.

kevin-ps: Please confirm customer-facing note. Elaine, can you send confirmation email to Vega that platform fee credit applied and invoice adjusted? Include PO and credit ref.

elaine-am: Will do now. Drafted email and sent to procurement contact. Copying legal and finance per process.

maria-finance: Closing loop — recorded in migration concessions spreadsheet (sheet row 453), tagged with CR-2026-058 and BILL-5578. All good from finance.

kevin-ps: Great — thanks team :tada:

natasha-legal: Saved addendum email to contract folder. No further action.

billing-bot: NOTE: Reserved capacity charges remain unchanged and will invoice per contract cycle.

kevin-ps: Resolving. If customer pushes for reserved capacity prorate we will open a new thread. Thanks everyone.
